name: setProfileString
description: Sets the value of a profile entry in an initialization file.
syntax: setProfileString( string iniPath, string section, string entry, string value )

params.name: section
params.description:
Section of the initialization file in which the entry is
to be set

params.name: entry
params.description: Name of the entry to set

params.name: value
params.description: Value to which to set the entry
